definitions.explanation: Making continuous, reliable progress toward a goal. Implies methodical advancement without rushing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{着々|ちゃくちゃく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{着々|ちゃくちゃく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
{着々|ちゃくちゃく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{実績|じっせき}→実績：04214_jisseki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}み{重|かさ}ねて→積み重ねる：06235_tsumikasaneru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: They have steadily built up their track record.

notes:
PATTERN: {着々|ちゃくちゃく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ + verb (usually ⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧)

NUANCE: Implies reliable, methodical progress - neither too fast nor too slow. Often used positively to describe projects or preparations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {着々|ちゃくちゃく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ (to progress steadily)
- {着々|ちゃくちゃく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to prepare steadily)
- {着々|ちゃくちゃく}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{力|ちから}→力：01661_chikara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (to steadily gain strength)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{徐々|じょじょ}に→徐々に：04131_jojoni⟧ (gradually - slower pace)
- ⟦{順調|じゅんちょう}→順調：03282_junchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (smoothly - emphasizes no problems)
- ⟦{確実|かくじつ}→確実：02538_kakujitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (certainly, reliably)
